files.notes: The hole sewing pair was made by the SVG import, not by Modify Overlap > Set hole sewing: after import, Modify Overlap showed Cancel hole sewing enabled for the pentagon. Cancelling it and then selecting both shapes and choosing Set hole sewing reported 'Invalid pair was selected!!' every time (also with Ctrl+A), so the import's own pair was kept. The import centres the pentagon and star on the page: the pentagon shows 38.00 x 36.20 mm (spec 38.04 x 36.18 mm), about 1.7 mm lower than the spec's absolute position; the star keeps its place relative to the pentagon. Thread colours mapped by the import were not changed.
